title: Advanced Configuration drawer: replace developer language with operator-appropriate copy
goal: The wizard's Advanced Configuration drawer shows developer-facing terms that operators should not see: (1) 'ADVANCED CONFIGURATION / Deterministic Run Controls' header — 'Deterministic Run Controls' is implementation terminology. Rename to 'Expert Settings' or just 'Advanced Configuration'. (2) 'These controls write into the same run configuration that the conversational intake is building.' — rewrite to: 'Fine-tune modules, credentials, profiles, and safety limits for this assessment.' (3) The Type tab duplicates the tile grid with radio buttons — this is confusing because the operator already selected tiles. Change the Type tab header to 'Assessment Type (change)' and add a note: 'Already set from tile selection. Change here only to override.' (4) 'What changed?' links throughout — rename to 'Why?' or remove if they are non-functional placeholder links. (5) In the AI section of the drawer, the ChatGPT connection block appears every time the drawer is opened — only show it if ChatGPT is not yet connected; if connected, show a small connected badge instead.
scope: Visual audit 2026-05-03: screenshot 03-wizard-advanced-config-open.png shows 'Deterministic Run Controls', developer description text, duplicated Type selection, and 'What changed?' links.
generation_reason: Visual audit 2026-05-03: Advanced Config drawer uses developer language throughout — needs operator-appropriate copy.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
